question: Estimate the conversions for an Indian study-abroad consultancy from initial inquiry to enrolled student.
idealClarificationQuestions: Edu consultancies (Yocket, Leverage Edu, IDP Education, Career Counselor, GREedge etc.)? Yes.
Inquiry = filled form / WhatsApp / called office? Yes.
Conversion = enrolled into a foreign university? Yes.
Time horizon: 12-18 months from inquiry? Yes.
